data.text:
Luke, I appreciate you offering to take zero, but I’d rather keep the lake full and give everyone a steady income—including you. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next catch.

With 100 tons now, we can each take 10 tons, earn $10,000, and leave 50 to replenish the lake completely. Your trial gives us 60 tons this month but requires just 30 next month to recover: 90 tons over two months, versus 100 with a steady 50-ton harvest.

I’ll commit to 10 tons this month and propose the same limit for all five of us. We can review the revealed catches together each month. Luke, would you join that agreement?
